intro: Our UK immigration for employers service covers everything from getting a sponsor licence to staying compliant and running right to work checks, so you can hire from overseas with confidence.

sections.heading: Why UK immigration for employers needs care
sections.text: Sponsoring workers brings real duties. The Home Office can visit without warning, and gaps in records or reporting can lead to a downgrade, suspension or loss of your licence. Our UK immigration for employers service helps you get it right from the start and stay that way.

sections.heading: Hiring a Skilled Worker
sections.text: Once you hold a licence, you assign a Certificate of Sponsorship and your worker applies for a [Skilled Worker visa](/skilled-worker-visa/). We can handle both sides.

faqs.q: Do I need a sponsor licence to employ someone from overseas?
faqs.a: For most work visas, yes, including workers already in the UK on another visa who want to switch.

faqs.q: Can you help with compliance after we get a licence?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer compliance support, including mock audits and HR record set-up.
